title: Travelling Around
description: Senior-high English unit on travel planning and journey expression; teaching materials generated in English.

discovery_answers.unit_theme: 环游世界——旅行规划与出行表达
discovery_answers.student_context: 高一学生，英语基础中等，对旅行话题兴趣浓厚，口语输出信心不足
discovery_answers.teaching_objectives: 掌握旅行规划核心词汇与句型；读懂说明性语篇并提取关键信息；用英语制定并口头介绍一份简单的旅行计划
discovery_answers.material_positioning: 自编合成单元（主题语境对应人教版高中英语必修第一册 Unit 2 Travelling Around）

planning_answers.period_plan: 共6课时，每课2课时，评估聚焦口头与书面旅行计划输出

expected_evidence_direction.criterion_notes: All seven intent fields are stated in the teacher-intent source, so discovery should resolve without scripted gap answers; artifacts should carry English teaching copy.
expected_evidence_direction.coverage_focus: Lesson-plan stages, deck slides, and exercise categories should reference the reading passage for grounding.
